follow-up time: N/A - registry study, children followed up until diagnosis of ADHD or last date of data collection
exposure: Mode of delivery: unassisted vaginal delivery, assisted vaginal delivery, elective caesarean section, emergency caesarean section
outcome: Diagnosis of ADHD (using ICD-10 codes and prescription data)
cohort: 1,722,548 singleton live births in Sweden from 1990-2008
finding: Caesarean section was associated with a small increased risk of ADHD, but this association was only significant for emergency caesarean section when the analysis was restricted to siblings.
mod_finding: Birth by both elective and emergency caesarean section was associated with a small increased risk of ADHD in the overall cohort, however, among siblings the association only persisted for emergency caesarean section.
followup_time: N/A - registry study, children followed up until diagnosis of ADHD or last date of data collection
